definitions.gloss: flower field; flower bed; flower garden
definitions.explanation: A field or area where flowers are grown or bloom in abundance. Can refer to a cultivated flower garden or a natural meadow full of flowers.
Used figuratively and often sarcastically to describe someone whose thinking is naive, unrealistic, or blissfully detached from reality — as if their head is full of flowers.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}の{花畑|はなばたけ}は{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: The flower fields in spring are beautiful.

examples.japanese: ラベンダーの{花畑|はなばたけ}を{見|み}に{北海道|ほっかいどう}へ{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to Hokkaido to see the lavender fields.

examples.japanese: {丘|おか}の{上|うえ}に{広|ひろ}がる{花畑|はなばたけ}は、{観光客|かんこうきゃく}に{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: The flower fields spreading across the hilltop are popular with tourists.

examples.japanese: {頭|あたま}の{中|なか}が{花畑|はなばたけ}だ。
examples.english: Their head is full of flowers. (They're living in dreamland.)

examples.japanese: {恋|こい}をすると{頭|あたま}の{中|なか}が{花畑|はなばたけ}になる。
examples.english: When you fall in love, your head turns into a flower field. (You become starry-eyed.)

examples.japanese: あの{人|ひと}は{頭|あたま}の{中|なか}が{花畑|はなばたけ}で、{現実|げんじつ}が{見|み}えていない。
examples.english: That person is living in la-la land and can't see reality.

notes:
A compound of {花|はな} (flower) and {畑|はたけ} (field). The literal meaning is straightforward, but the figurative usage {頭|あたま}の{中|なか}が{花畑|はなばたけ} (head full of flowers) is very common in casual speech and online.

USAGE:
The expression {頭|あたま}の{中|なか}が{花畑|はなばたけ} or お{花畑|はなばたけ} describes someone blissfully naive or out of touch with reality. It can be used self-deprecatingly about being love-struck, or critically about someone ignoring problems.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花畑|はなばたけ}が{広|ひろ}がる — flower fields spread out
- お{花畑|はなばたけ} — flower garden (with polite お); also used for the figurative sense
- {頭|あたま}の{中|なか}が{花畑|はなばたけ} — head full of flowers; starry-eyed, naive

RELATED WORDS:
- {花園|はなぞの} — flower garden; more literary and poetic
- {畑|はたけ} — field, farm; the general word for cultivated fields
